note: Sequoia NF (Kern River RD) dispersed camping on open dirt flats sloping gently to the NE shore of Lake Isabella; rigs park across the flats, and the shoreline moves a long way with the reservoir level. No toilets, tables or trash service: bring a portable toilet and pack everything out. --Claude
summary: Hanning Flat (Sequoia NF): free, year-round, dispersed, no water/tables/trash and no toilet (vault_toilets cleared); lakefront kept on a gentle open apron; pin is in the water at high lake -> move ~670 m up to the high-water line; phone and website flagged.
flags: WATERFRONT lakefront kept (Claude value): the FS page calls it 'Dispersed Camping on the shore of Lake Isabella'; there are no numbered sites, rigs park anywhere on open dirt flats that fall about 2% (3DEP 799 m at the FS point to ~785 m at the willow line, no bank) straight to the water, so the kayak test passes at any level. Measured to the high-water edge: Isabella's full pool (~2,605 ft, ~794 m) reaches about 35.6770,-118.3725, and open ground on the flats above it (795-799 m) lies within ~50 m of that edge. Caveat in the note that the shore moves with the reservoir.

PIN: stored 35.6720,-118.3765 sits in the lake on the Esri imagery (high water, flooded willows; 3DEP 784.5 m, below full pool). Move ~670 m NE to about 35.6772,-118.3728 (top of the flats at the full-pool line, ~795 m); the FS page gives 35.678111,-118.371722 (~130 m further up, by the upper track).
